name: Jia Wei Lim
bio:
Jia Wei's fascination with motorsport began during his national service, where he was stationed near the Changi pit lane. The roaring engines and high-stakes atmosphere ignited a passion that led him to pursue a career ensuring the safety and security of racing teams. He started as a junior security officer, rapidly gaining experience in crowd control, perimeter security, and incident response.

At V8 Masters Racing, Jia Wei is known for his meticulous approach to security protocols. He believes in proactive risk assessment and continuous improvement, always seeking new ways to enhance safety measures. His flexible and adaptable nature makes him a valuable asset in the dynamic world of motorsport, where unexpected challenges are the norm. He's particularly adept at using data analytics to predict potential security breaches and allocate resources effectively.

Jia Wei's ambition extends beyond maintaining the status quo. He is determined to implement cutting-edge security technologies and strategies to make V8 Masters Racing a benchmark for safety in the sport. His loyalty to the team and his relentless pursuit of excellence make him a rising star in motorsport security.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: Jia Wei has a lean build and a focused gaze that reflects his dedication.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down potential security risks.
Drinks at least three cups of strong kopi (Singaporean coffee) before each race.
Obsessively checks and re-checks security camera feeds, even when nothing is happening.
